Addition theorem and parity establish spectra. Gegenbauer residue-period C_k^(2)(1/2) and C_k^(2)(0) yield high degree |p|,|q| bounds; cubic inequalities show full rank for odd k>=5 and even k>=10, low even k6,8 exact. For k10 p=-4/143 q=-3/143, levels (18,144,150)/143 yield 25/3; tail uniform bounds 55/17 and 226/47 control other degrees. Independent exact 36x36 scheme and 61 rational Gegenbauer degrees match, but infinite assertion relies on inequalities.
